_note: The golden set: frozen issues the loop is replayed on, each with a grader in eval/issues/<n>/ that fails on the base commit and passes with the reference fix (eval.sh validate). 'base' is the commit before the fix, frozen, so the issue stays unfixed however main moves. Add issues with golden.sh; keep them to mixed first-run outcomes (neither always solved nor never).
